location_note: Random RSR slopes per location as in Laub et al. (2022). 'Reference' (58 studies) reproduces the eleven published predictions to within rounding (max |diff| 0.005); latitude-longitude sites (59) also pass the gate (max 0.033) and are reported as a sensitivity (outputs/phase4_gate_variants.csv).
controls_note: Rows with RSR = 0 are the unshaded controls (89 rows, all 100 %); kept in the fit as in the paper's 428 data points. They lie on the fixed origin and only inform the residual variance.
